entities.name: Brandt
entities.description: An aged Innistrad vampire hunter whose prime target was Strefan Maurer; he sacrificed himself to trap Strefan.

entities.name: Strefan Maurer
entities.description: A vampire hunted by Brandt, trapped in a supernatural mansion.

entities.name: Hladvora
entities.description: Unknown entity that reanimated Brandt's body.

entities.name: Brandt's mansion
entities.description: A ruin turned by Brandt's blood into a nightmarish mansion that traps Strefan.

events.summary: Brandt lures Strefan into a pit lined with stakes; Strefan survives, escapes and injures Brandt.
events.quote: Brandt managed to lure Strefan Maurer into a pit lined with wooden stakes

events.summary: Brandt's horse collapses and he flees on foot to a nearby ruin.
events.quote: his horse eventually collapsed, forcing him to flee on foot to a nearby ruin

events.summary: Brandt slits his own throat, his blood turning the ruin into a mansion that traps Strefan.
events.quote: slits his own throat, sacrificing himself in a bid to trap Strefan in the ruin

events.summary: Brandt's body is reanimated by the Hladvora and haunts Strefan; Strefan barely escapes.
events.quote: The story concludes with Strefan barely escaping the house

relations.quote: had Strefan Maurer as his prime target for years
